pages.text: Place the basin with room for all nine cells. If blocked, clear a wider patch. Use the center or a wall to open it.
Load water into the tank with a vessel or pipe. Put the exact ingredients in separate ingredient slots. A valid match starts a short stew and converts the whole water volume into the mash.

pages.title: After the Bubbles
pages.text: The tank locks transfers while working. When it finishes, serve the mash, leave it open to ferment, or move the batch to another compatible tank. Find exact inputs in the $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/mash_catalog)mash catalogue$(/l).
